description: Input: the same fields as quote_trends, plus sort. What is taking off in a niche or on a topic, and what to make next: reels that took off, up to 10 per platform, one per creator, TikTok and Instagram ranked by x_median. Charged only on success, a one-platform mix too; 10 per hour. poll names get_trend_search, free; sort reorders it free. No keywords: the primary saved niche (trend_niches). gallery_url: a page to share for 7 days. next_page: more places, free for 24 hours after the search, 10 a day, then 10 credits; up to 5 pages, search_id and page alone. Price: 20 credits per call. Quote first with quote_trends.
name: find_trends
title: Find trending reels on a topic
